_comment: Battle scene settings (Battle System v2: the Attack and Defense bars move on their own; tap one to act).
Each bar starts slow and speeds up to its top speed on a curve (the equipped gear sets both; with none:
starts at 15, top speed 200, reached after 1.8 s, on a bar 120 long). The two are scaled separately:
bar_slow_speed_scale: multiplies the slow start (1 = as the gear sets it; lower = even slower start).
bar_fast_speed_scale: multiplies the top speed it speeds up to (higher = faster after the slow start).
bar_cooldown_ms: after a tap, how long that bar waits (milliseconds) before it moves again.
Read when the game starts; without this file the game uses 1, 1 and 1500.
attack_pause_ms: while the player or the enemy attacks, BOTH sides' clocks pause this long (the bars do not
move or cool down, the enemy's clock waits) -- the owner's rule, docs/gameplay/07_GAMEPLAY_PLAN.md §4. 0 turns it off.
hit_number_delay_ms: the damage number appears this long after the attack starts (when the swing lands).
pace (docs/gameplay/13_BATTLE_EDITOR.md §6.3, the owner 2026-10-25: both, switchable): "cooldown" = each bar waits
bar_cooldown_ms after a tap (as before); "stamina" = no waits, but starting an attack and each guard tap cost stamina,
which refills while no attack runs (stamina: max, regenPerS, attack, guard). A weapon (weapon_play.json "pace") or a
battle setup can override it.
break (§6.4): points = matched points that fill a monster's gauge (enemies.json "break" overrides it); a full gauge
stuns it brokenMs and its hits take brokenDamage times. A heavy blow (data/moves.json) guarded with parryPower or more
is parried: it staggers parryMs, takes parryDamage times, and parryBreak goes on its gauge; breaking a guard adds guardBreak.
combo_holds_monsters: false (the owner 2026-10-26) = the monsters keep charging while the player's combo runs, and their
attack lands in the middle of it; true = their clocks wait for the combo (as before). Quick jabs never wait.
combo_runs_through_attacks: true (the owner 2026-10-30) = a running combo's marker keeps moving through attack_pause_ms
when a monster attacks in the middle of it; false = the marker stops for that pause (as before).
The revamp (docs/gameplay/15_BATTLE_REVAMP.md): feel = the moments' hit stop (stopMs: both sides freeze), screen
shake (shakePx, over shakeMs) and sound per moment (hit, great, perfect, miss, parry, block, break, hurt, heavyHurt,

ultimate, phase, win); strength scales them all (Q34); slowMoMs / slowMoScale: the last hit in slow motion; then the last attack clip ends, and the end clip plays before the result: winBigClip with no damage taken, winParClip with winParHp of the HP or less, else winClip; loseClip when HP is gone; endMaxMs: the longest this may wait;
reducedScale: the player's 'Reduce shaking and flashes'; chainStep: each perfect in a row adds this much damage.
grade = the win's S / A / B / C (Q35): 100 - seconds over par x timePenalty - HP lost share x damagePenalty +
perfect rate x perfectBonus + best chain x chainBonus; s / a / b the lowest score of each; an S gives sGold more gold
and a card sCard likelier. guard: mode 'timing' = one button pressed just before a hit (parryMs: a parry, blockMs:
blocked at blockPower, earlyMs: too early), cooldownMs between presses; 'bar' = the five-zone bar of Battle v2.
docs/gameplay/16: guard mode 'warn' = only while the "!" shows over the monster (warnMs before each hit; its first
parryShare a parry); a press with no "!" locks missLockMs, and a press stops the player's own attack.
plays: the weapons' plays (touch_play.h): the bow's target move (bowMoveMs, bowMoveDist), its charge limit (bowHoldMs
+ bowHoldPerStr per STR) and shake (bowShakePx / (1 + DEX x bowShakePerDex)); the sword's prompts (cueMs, of which
inputMs take the answer, at the end when inputAtEnd); the staff's count / hide / warn / tap times.

cueExtraMs: more time for a prompt that takes longer to draw (17 §4.2). dexWayDeg / dexWayMaxDeg: a swipe's tolerance per DEX point and its limit; dexGestureMaxDeg: a gesture's limit; dexCornerPct: a shape's corners per point; dexWindowMs: the answer window per point (17 §4.4). freeMinSwipe: a shorter drag is no swipe in a free mode (17 §5).

backdrops: the battle's background by floor (17 §19): the first row whose from..to holds the floor, else the first. anim, clip: covers the screen (size: the picture's size); fx: looping effects of battle.particle over it. tools/art/make_battle_backdrop.py writes the forest.

cells: moving in battle (docs/gameplay/19 §2.1): six cells, 0 1 2 the near row and 3 4 5 the far row; start: where the hero begins; warnMs: the danger lights this long before the hit; shapes: each a list of variants, each the cells it covers (a move names one in moves.json "shape"; the variant reaching the hero is chosen); shiftX, shiftNear, shiftY: how far the hero's picture moves.

stages3d: the battle on a 3D stage (docs/gameplay/21_BATTLE_3D.md), by floor like backdrops (from..to); a floor without one keeps its backdrop. sky (an HDR: hdr, intensity, yaw, blur), ground, shadow, sprites (the fighters' and the fires' 2D sprites placed in the scene, lit by it: glow = their own light, off = drawn 2D over the stage), props (model, node: only that root node of it, at, turn, scale), light (dir, color, intensity, ambient), exposure; fires (at, fx, color, intensity, range, flicker, lightHeight, size: a flickering point light + its particles), clouds (min, speed: the moonlight drifting), flash (onMonster, onHero, intensity, range, ms, off: a hit lights the stage); camera (eye, look, fov, aspect it was made for, breathe; danger: a special attack's low close-up on its monster: zoom, height, lookAt, fovAdd, deg, ms, rumble, off), marks (hero, monster, spacing, monsters2 / monsters3), heights (hero, monster, big) in metres. tools/battle3d/make_moonlit_ruins.py writes moonlit_ruins (one .glb per model).
battleSpeeds: the steps of Settings > Battle speed (17 I10).
training: the training ground (16 §5): cards spent per run, runs per day, fights per run, EXP and weapon EXP x.

tutorial._comment: The new game's trial fight (docs/gameplay/19 B6). Each step shows its text until doneOn happens count times; once: not again for the next weapon tried; hideMs: its box goes away that long after it popped up (the step goes on).

onFoeDeath._comment: what a monster's own effects and sounds do when it falls (CLAUDE.md "Battle effects belong to their monster"): stop (at once), fade (no more particles, those out finish; the sound fades out over fadeMs), keep (plays to its end); default for the rest

bodyScale._comment: a monster's body type (enemies.json "body", 1 small .. 5 huge): times the stage's monster height (stages3d heights monster)

feelFx._comment: The attack feel (docs/gameplay/20): the effects are in media/fx/battle.particle (tools/make_battle_fx.py), the sounds by key.
